mapping.draft_py:
keywords = []
abilities = [
    # [0] Whenever a creature you control enters, scry 1.
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=ZoneChangeEvent(
            from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            subject=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            )),
        ),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.SCRY, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=1)}),
    ),
    # [1] Whenever you cast a spell that targets a creature you control, draw a card.
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=CastSpellEvent(
            filter=FAtom(
                pred=FAtomPred.TARGETS,
                inner_filter=FAnd(children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                )),
            ),
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        ),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
    # [2]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.ENCHANTMENT),
]
